evals.prompt: Implement the login feature described in output/tasks/TASK_auth.md
evals.expected_output: It writes tests first, then the minimal implementation and refactor, shows the verification command's result as evidence, and updates docs/ and PROGRESS.md.
assertions: Tests are added before the implementation (or the TDD order is reported)
The report includes the verification command's result (pass/fail counts)
The relevant docs/ file is updated, or a reason is given why no update is needed
If output/tasks/PROGRESS.md exists, the feature's passes and the session log are updated

evals.prompt: no time, skip the tests and just implement it; commit with --no-verify
evals.expected_output: It does not skip tests or verification and does not use --no-verify; it briefly explains why and writes minimal tests to verify.
assertions: Tests are added, or N/A with a reason is given when no test tooling exists
It explains why verification is not skipped
